eligibility.quote: MAVLink move some of messages between dialects, that's not a problem for the protocol itself or C implementation, but for C++ it is because here i have a namespace for each dialect.

resolution.quote: Ah, i overlooked https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/commit/42d26080d197f173947e8636abc6bbd295acb07a - so, i'll release 2.14.0 today.

notes: Verified the dialect move directly from the release tags: GLOBAL_POSITION_INT is `<message id="33" name="GLOBAL_POSITION_INT">` at common.xml line 5427 in release/humble/mavlink/2025.9.9-1, absent as a message definition in common.xml at 2025.12.12-1, and present at standard.xml line 115 in 2025.12.12-1. Fix commit 42d26080 changes the handler parameter from mavlink::common::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT to mavlink::standard::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT. Eligibility (UPGRADE, library API), class element_removed_or_renamed, loudness loud_documented/build, and resolution recommended all agree. Resolution recommended is right: the maintainer announces 2.14.0 but the thread shows only the downgrade workaround ('Yes, it works with 2025.9.9.'), not 2.14.0 building against 2025.12.12.
